tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: All measured parameters are within normal limits except for a minimally elevated chloride, which is unlikely to be clinically significant in isolation. Renal function, glucose, and electrolytes are normal. No acute laboratory abnormalities detected; recommend correlation with clinical context.
